questions.text: How should payments get from BC to your bank?
questions.help: Direct means no file to download and upload.

options.label: Sent directly from BC to the bank
patterns: without (manual file|file handling|web portal)|no file (export|exchange)|without files

options.label: Export a payment file and upload it in the web bank
Domestic bank transfers (SEPA or local formats)
Foreign and multi-currency payments
patterns: multi-?currency|multiple currencies|all currencies|regardless of currency|\d+\+? currencies

questions.text: What controls do you want before money leaves?
questions.help: These guard against fraud and mistakes.

options.label: Someone approves payments first
patterns: for payment$|approval of posted purchase invoices for payment

options.label: Changes to vendor bank details need approval
patterns: (vendor|employee|customer)( and vendor)? bank (account|detail)s?[^.]*(approv|change)|approv\w*[^.]*(vendor|employee) bank|bank account approval

options.label: Check that the bank account really belongs to the vendor

questions.text: Should the same app also bring bank statements into BC?
questions.help: Lets payments and bank reconciliation run in one tool.

options.label: Yes, import statements and match them
patterns: bank feeds|loads bank transactions|imports? (and applies )?bank transactions|fetches [^.]*transactions

questions.text: Do you pay from several banks?
questions.help: Some apps cover hundreds of banks through one connection.

options.label: Yes, several banks, maybe in several countries

ignoredTopics.label: bank detail checks already covered by the controls options
